name: TempoFlex — Date Filter
summary: Flexible Power BI date filter with quick periods, custom cycles and a native date picker.
description:
TempoFlex combines date selection, quick periods and custom reporting cycles in one Power BI visual. Bind a Date or Date/Time column without an auxiliary table or measure.

Choose a range with Between, a single unit with Is, or a value from a searchable chronological Dropdown. Select year, month, day, hour, minute or second precision. The browser-native date picker can extend beyond the visual area.

Create shortcuts such as Today, Last 7 days, Previous month and Current year. Configure a default period, custom monthly cycles and fiscal years using expressions. Hide date fields to display only quick periods and customize button placement, layout, fonts and colors.

An optional slider depends on the date fields. The configuration guide in edit mode explains expressions and identifies invalid lines.

Limitations: the browser determines the native picker controls; there is no year-only native picker. Seconds can be typed if the popup does not expose them. The searchable Dropdown stays within the visual area and depends on data delivered by Power BI. Relative periods recalculate when the visual updates. The visual settings and built-in guide are currently in Portuguese.

The visual code does not transmit report data to external services. Licensed under GPL-3.0-only. See the offer links for privacy, terms and documentation. This independent project does not claim Microsoft certification.

Developer: Lucas Machado Balbinot. Community support is available through the TempoFlex GitHub repository.
